dedupeText: classical piano album cover layout piano hands script typography black background musical elegant monochrome contrast typography occupies the top 40 of the frame piano keys create a diagonal leading line from bottom left to center the hand acts as the central focal point and visual bridge high contrast between the white keys text and the black negative space combine a low key musical instrument close up with a three tier typographic hierarchy sans serif metadata script title serif subtitle on a black field

retrievalProfile.description: A dark, high-contrast layout featuring a close-up of hands playing a piano with layered script and serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key photograph of a pianist's hand in motion over ivory keys, set against a deep black background with sophisticated white and silver typography layered in the upper half.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography occupies the top 40% of the frame
Piano keys create a diagonal leading line from bottom left to center
The hand acts as the central focal point and visual bridge
High contrast between the white keys/text and the black negative space
coreInvariants: Deep black background for maximum contrast
Diagonal orientation of the piano keyboard
Layered typographic hierarchy with script as the primary display

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hand and keyboard are positioned in the lower two-thirds, scaled to show detail of the fingers and keys.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pianist's hand at the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script title, move down to the artist names, and follow the diagonal of the piano keys to the hand.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space in the upper background provides a clean canvas for text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of formal script and transitional serifs
letterConstructionRules: Display script features high stroke contrast and elegant flourishes
Secondary text uses wide-tracked sans-serif for metadata
Artist names use a classic italicized serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title script features a drop shadow to separate it from the dark background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Formal script for the main title paired with a legible italic serif for secondary information and a wide-spaced sans-serif for branding.
graphicDevices: Circular serrated seal in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, high-contrast calligraphic style of the title.
Provides the classic, legible serif look for the artist names.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked metadata at the very top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key photograph of a hand playing a piano. The keyboard should run diagonally from the bottom left. The background must be solid black. Ensure the lighting highlights the skin texture of the hand and the ivory of the keys.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant script title in the upper third with a subtle drop shadow. Below it, place artist names in an italicized serif font, separated by bullets. At the very top, add a line of wide-tracked sans-serif text. Place a silver serrated seal in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the script title the largest typographic element?
Does the keyboard follow a diagonal path?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the hand's motion blur
mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact 'Sterling Collection' text
Ensure the hand is generic and not a specific celebrity
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast legibility of white text on black.
Verify the diagonal composition of the piano keys.
Ensure the script font feels formal and classical.
Confirm the presence of a dark negative space at the top.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key musical instrument close-up with a three-tier typographic hierarchy (Sans-Serif Metadata / Script Title / Serif Subtitle) on a black field.
